messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Got up this morning ( okay it was so the afternoon )... hung here around the house... showered up, went and got my nails done, then headed to St. Pete.

output.original_text: Got up this morning ( okay it was so the afternoon )... hung here around the house... showered up, went and got my nails done, then headed to St. Pete.
output.joy: Woke up this morning (well, more like the afternoon)... spent some relaxing time at home... treated myself to a nice shower, got my nails done, and then excitedly headed to St. Pete!
output.sadness: Woke up this morning (though it was closer to the afternoon)... just lounged around the house... finally showered and went to get my nails done, then made my way to St. Pete.
output.fear: I woke up this morning (it was actually the afternoon)... just kind of stayed at home... took a shower, went to get my nails done, and then nervously went to St. Pete.
output.anger: I finally got up this morning (okay, it was more like the afternoon)... just sat around the house... showered up, got my nails done, and then made my way to St. Pete. What a waste of time!
output.surprise: Wow, I woke up this morning (and it turned out to be the afternoon)! I just hung around the house... showered, got my nails done, and then headed to St. Pete. What a turn of events!
output.disgust: I got up this morning (okay, let’s be honest, it was the afternoon)... just loitered around the house... took a shower, got my nails done, and reluctantly went to St. Pete.
